signals.title: Peer-review Global Talent endorsements repeatedly exceeding usual assessment timing

other_conditions: Global Talent Route 4 / full peer-review endorsement via Royal Academy of Engineering or Royal Society

signals.summary_en: Multiple independent 2026 applicants reported Route 4 peer-review endorsement waits of roughly 8–14 weeks, especially through the Royal Academy of Engineering and also the Royal Society. This is narrower than Global Talent overall and does not apply to fast-track Routes 1–3.
signals.summary_fa: چند متقاضی مستقل در سال ۲۰۲۶ برای اندورسمنت روت ۴ (Peer Review)، به‌ویژه در Royal Academy of Engineering و نیز Royal Society، انتظار حدود ۸ تا ۱۴ هفته را گزارش کرده‌اند. این سیگنال مربوط به کل ویزای Global Talent یا روت‌های سریع ۱ تا ۳ نیست.
signals.practical_impact: A fixed job start, funding start, current-visa expiry, or travel plan can become difficult if the applicant budgets only the usual five-week endorsement timing.
signals.who_should_care: Global Talent Route 4 applicants whose endorsing body is the Royal Academy of Engineering or Royal Society, especially applicants with immovable start or immigration-status deadlines.
signals.recommended_action: Budget for a longer Stage 1 window, avoid making non-refundable commitments around the nominal five-week timing, and use official follow-up channels after the stated window.
signals.known_workaround: If lawful stay is close to expiry, assess the separate Stage 2 timing rules; endorsement alone does not extend UK permission.

official_verification.note: Official sources confirm the nominal timing (usually 5 weeks; Royal Society says Route 4 Stage 1 can take up to 8 weeks), but do not publish a current 8–14 week backlog. The extended waits are community-observed.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Apply only when the applicant is using Route 4 peer review through the Royal Academy of Engineering or Royal Society and a fixed deadline cannot absorb an approximately 8–14+ week Stage 1 wait.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: Repeated recent independent direct reports show material schedule risk. The penalty is timing/feasibility only, not an approval-rate estimate.

signals.title: Tehran UK Visa Application Centre closure resolved; centre reopened

other_conditions: Applicants intending to enrol biometrics or submit through the UK Visa Application Centre in Tehran

entities.name: VFS Global — Tehran UK Visa Application Centre

signals.summary_en: The Tehran UK Visa Application Centre was reported closed in early 2026, creating a temporary biometrics/submission barrier. Official VFS and GOV.UK sources now show the centre reopened and currently serves all UK visa categories. The British Embassy itself does not provide visa services.
signals.summary_fa: مرکز درخواست ویزای بریتانیا در تهران در اوایل ۲۰۲۶ به‌طور موقت بسته گزارش شد و دسترسی به بیومتریک/سابمیت را مختل کرد. منابع رسمی VFS و GOV.UK اکنون بازگشایی مرکز و ارائه خدمات برای همه دسته‌های ویزا را تأیید می‌کنند. سفارت بریتانیا خودِ خدمات ویزا ارائه نمی‌دهد.
signals.practical_impact: The past closure could force travel to a third country, but this specific barrier is not currently active.
signals.who_should_care: Applicants planning to use the Tehran UK Visa Application Centre.
signals.recommended_action: Use the current VFS UK-Iran centre page to confirm appointment availability before travel; do not treat the historical closure as current.
signals.known_workaround: During the closure applicants discussed using UK VACs in Türkiye or the UAE; that workaround is not currently required solely because of the historical closure.

official_verification.note: Current GOV.UK explicitly distinguishes the Embassy from the UKVI Visa Application Centre and states the Tehran VAC is open to all visa categories.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Never apply a current route penalty from this resolved closure.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: Resolved operational events must not reduce current fit unless a new closure is independently confirmed.

signals.title: Route 4 applicants without a completed PhD face evidence risk, not a formal PhD-only rule

other_conditions: Global Talent Route 4 peer review applicant relying on equivalent research experience rather than a completed PhD

signals.summary_en: A completed PhD is not an official Route 4 prerequisite: current rules allow equivalent research experience. Community evidence nevertheless shows meaningful scrutiny where applicants rely on that alternative. A successful 2026 counterexample demonstrates that a strong, well-documented equivalent-research case can succeed.
signals.summary_fa: مدرک دکتری تکمیل‌شده شرط رسمی مطلق برای روت ۴ نیست و مقررات فعلی «دکتری یا سابقه پژوهشی معادل» را می‌پذیرند. با این حال، شواهد جامعه نشان می‌دهد پرونده‌هایی که به سابقه معادل تکیه می‌کنند ممکن است با بررسی جدی مواجه شوند. یک نمونه موفق در ۲۰۲۶ نیز نشان می‌دهد اثبات قوی و مستندِ سابقه معادل می‌تواند موفق باشد.
signals.practical_impact: Applicants without a PhD should expect the quality and clarity of evidence for equivalent research experience to matter materially.
signals.who_should_care: Route 4 peer-review applicants who do not yet hold a PhD or who rely on industrial, clinical or other equivalent research experience.
signals.recommended_action: Frame the application around the official 'PhD or equivalent research experience' criterion and document research duration, outputs, role, independence and impact directly.
signals.known_workaround: A completed PhD is not required if equivalent research experience can be evidenced; do not delay automatically solely because the doctorate is unfinished.

official_verification.note: Official rules confirm the alternative to a PhD. They do not publish a practical refusal rate for applicants relying on equivalent experience; that scrutiny pattern remains community-derived.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Apply only when the applicant lacks a completed PhD and cannot clearly document equivalent research experience and research outputs. Do not apply merely because the PhD is unfinished.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The adjustment reflects practical evidence risk, not a new legal requirement. Direct successful evidence prevents treating unfinished PhD status as a route blocker.

signals.title: Digital Technology endorsement can scrutinize recommender standing beyond job title

other_conditions: Global Talent digital technology applicant relying on recommendation letters

signals.summary_en: A direct 2026 refusal report says Tech Nation questioned whether the applicant's recommenders were sufficiently recognized in the technology field. This aligns with the official requirement that each recommender be an established digital-technology expert; senior titles alone do not establish that criterion.
signals.summary_fa: در یک گزارش مستقیم رد شدن در ۲۰۲۶، Tech Nation جایگاه و شناخته‌شدگی توصیه‌کنندگان در حوزه فناوری را محل ایراد دانسته است. این با معیار رسمی «متخصص تثبیت‌شده در فناوری دیجیتال» هم‌راستاست؛ صرف داشتن عنوان مدیریتی بالا لزوماً این معیار را ثابت نمی‌کند.
signals.practical_impact: Weakly matched or insufficiently established recommenders can undermine an otherwise strong digital-technology endorsement package.
signals.who_should_care: Global Talent digital-technology applicants preparing the three required recommendation letters.
signals.recommended_action: Choose recommenders whose digital-technology expertise and standing are independently demonstrable and who have known the applicant's work for at least 12 months; make the relationship and concrete examples explicit.
signals.known_workaround: If a refusal is based on evidence quality and new evidence is needed, a fresh application may be more suitable than an endorsement review, because reviews cannot accept new evidence.

official_verification.source_title: GOV.UK — Global Talent digital technology documents
official_verification.note: The official criterion is confirmed; the frequency of refusals specifically for recommender standing is not published.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Apply only if one or more recommenders do not clearly meet the official established-expert standard, have not known the applicant's work for at least 12 months, or the letters poorly evidence those points.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: One directly reasoned refusal plus the explicit official criterion makes this a material selection risk, but not a general refusal-rate signal.

signals.title: A first Global Talent endorsement refusal does not create a permanent route bar

other_conditions: Global Talent applicant previously refused at endorsement Stage 1

signals.summary_en: Multiple direct experiences show successful fresh endorsement applications after an earlier refusal. Official guidance also allows a fresh application and distinguishes it from a review, which cannot introduce new evidence.
signals.summary_fa: چند تجربه مستقیم نشان می‌دهد پس از رد شدن اندورسمنت، امکان ثبت درخواست جدید و موفقیت وجود دارد. راهنمای رسمی نیز درخواست جدید را مجاز می‌داند و آن را از review جدا می‌کند؛ در review امکان ارائه مدرک جدید وجود ندارد.
signals.practical_impact: A prior Stage 1 refusal should trigger diagnosis of the refusal reasons, not an automatic permanent exclusion from Global Talent.
signals.who_should_care: Global Talent applicants deciding between endorsement review, a corrected fresh application, or abandoning the route after refusal.
signals.recommended_action: Use review when the issue is an assessment/process error; use a fresh application if material evidence or framing must be changed.
signals.known_workaround: Fresh endorsement application after correcting substantive weaknesses.

official_verification.source_title: GOV.UK — If your Global Talent endorsement is refused
official_verification.note: Official guidance confirms the procedural option; community reports provide successful counterexamples.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Positive resolution evidence may remove an earlier 'permanent bar' penalty but must never add eligibility points or imply likely approval.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: This signal corrects an overly negative inference; it does not increase official eligibility.

signals.title: Priority visa service is not a guaranteed five-working-day decision

other_conditions: Applicant paying for UKVI priority/faster decision service on an eligible work-route application

signals.summary_en: Two 2026 work-route applicants reported priority processing materially exceeding the expected fast-track window, while another Global Talent applicant received a decision on schedule. Official guidance says priority timing is usual rather than guaranteed and can be extended for additional checks.
signals.summary_fa: دو متقاضی مسیرهای کاری در ۲۰۲۶ از طولانی‌تر شدن محسوس پردازش Priority نسبت به بازه مورد انتظار خبر داده‌اند، در حالی که یک متقاضی Global Talent در همان بازه زمانی پاسخ گرفته است. راهنمای رسمی نیز زمان Priority را تضمین قطعی نمی‌داند و امکان تأخیر برای بررسی‌های اضافی را ذکر می‌کند.
signals.practical_impact: Applicants with a fixed start date can still miss that date even after paying for priority service.
signals.who_should_care: Eligible Global Talent or Skilled Worker applicants relying on priority timing for a fixed start, travel, or status deadline.
signals.recommended_action: Treat priority as a shorter target, not a guarantee; preserve contingency time and watch for requests for information or delay notices.
signals.known_workaround: Where available and appropriate, apply earlier rather than relying solely on priority service.

official_verification.note: Official guidance confirms that priority decisions can take longer. Community evidence is mixed and too small to infer a current general backlog.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Apply only when a route plan has an immovable deadline and its feasibility assumes the priority-service target will always be met.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: Mixed evidence supports a contingency penalty only for deadline-sensitive plans, not a blanket route penalty.

signals.title: Switching to Global Talent does not automatically remove ATAS obligations for relevant study

other_conditions: Non-ATAS-exempt nationality
ATAS-listed course or research
Global Talent or other permission allowing study

signals.summary_en: A PhD applicant reported a study interruption after switching to Global Talent because the university still required ATAS. Current official rules confirm that Global Talent permission can carry an ATAS condition for relevant study/research. This is not a blanket ATAS requirement for every Global Talent holder.
signals.summary_fa: یک دانشجوی دکتری پس از تغییر ویزا به Global Talent به‌دلیل نیاز دانشگاه به ATAS با وقفه در تحصیل مواجه شد. مقررات فعلی نیز تأیید می‌کند که برای برخی تحصیل‌ها/پژوهش‌های مشمول ATAS، دارنده Global Talent همچنان ممکن است نیاز به گواهی داشته باشد. این الزام برای همه دارندگان Global Talent عمومی نیست.
signals.practical_impact: A visa switch can leave an applicant unable to resume an ATAS-controlled course or research activity until a valid certificate is in place.
signals.who_should_care: Non-exempt nationals on Global Talent who intend to continue or start ATAS-listed postgraduate study or research.
signals.recommended_action: Check the current ATAS nationality, subject and activity rules before switching or resuming study; coordinate with the education provider in advance.
signals.known_workaround: Obtain or renew the required ATAS certificate before the planned return to study/research.

official_verification.note: Official rules confirm the scoped ATAS condition. The reported one-month interruption is an individual operational experience.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Apply only when the applicant is non-exempt, the planned study/research is ATAS-controlled, and the required certificate is not already valid.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The risk can stop study/research execution temporarily but does not create a blanket Global Talent eligibility penalty.

signals.title: Ecctis document correction can create Skilled Worker timeline risk

other_conditions: Skilled Worker applicant relying on an overseas English-taught degree and Ecctis assessment to meet the English requirement

signals.summary_en: One detailed 2026 Skilled Worker experience shows that a document-format correction in Ecctis assessment can restart a substantial review period. The applicant used an approved UKVI English test instead. This is a single-case operational warning, not evidence of a general Ecctis backlog.
signals.summary_fa: یک تجربه جزئی‌نگر در ۲۰۲۶ نشان می‌دهد نقص شکلی مدارک در ارزیابی Ecctis می‌تواند زمان بررسی را طولانی کند. متقاضی برای حفظ زمان‌بندی به آزمون زبان مورد تأیید UKVI روی آورد. این یک هشدار تک‌موردی است و نشانه بک‌لاگ عمومی Ecctis نیست.
signals.practical_impact: If English evidence is left late, a verification correction can threaten a sponsorship or current-status deadline.
signals.who_should_care: Skilled Worker applicants using an overseas degree rather than a SELT to satisfy English.
signals.recommended_action: Start Ecctis early and verify transcript/document requirements before upload; compare approved SELT availability if the deadline is tight.
signals.known_workaround: Use an approved SELT if eligible and operationally faster.

official_verification.source_title: GOV.UK — Skilled Worker knowledge of English
official_verification.note: Official guidance confirms Ecctis and SELT pathways, but not the reported restart timing or any generalized delay.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Single anecdote: do not apply a route penalty. Use only as a document-timeline warning.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The evidence does not establish a repeatable backlog or refusal pattern.

evidence.evidence_summary: Applicant reports Ecctis requested a re-upload because the transcript lacked a university seal and then restarted an approximately one-month assessment window; the applicant instead used a UKVI-approved PTE test to protect the visa timeline.

evidence.evidence_summary: Current guidance states that an overseas degree taught in English can be assessed by Ecctis and that an approved Secure English Language Test is another route to prove English.

signals.title: Skilled Worker status allows study, but university/funder/employer constraints can still matter

other_conditions: Skilled Worker holder considering full-time study or PhD alongside sponsored work

signals.summary_en: Current immigration guidance allows Skilled Workers to study if it does not interfere with the sponsored job, subject to ATAS where relevant. Community discussion shows that universities, doctoral funders, or employers may still impose separate workload or funding constraints. A direct full-time master's counterexample disproves the blanket claim that Skilled Worker status itself forbids study.
signals.summary_fa: راهنمای فعلی مهاجرت اجازه تحصیل به دارنده Skilled Worker را می‌دهد، به شرط آنکه با شغل اسپانسری تداخل نداشته باشد و در صورت لزوم ATAS رعایت شود. با این حال دانشگاه، فاند دکتری یا کارفرما ممکن است محدودیت‌های جداگانه داشته باشند. یک تجربه مستقیم تحصیل تمام‌وقت، ادعای «ممنوعیت کلی تحصیل با Skilled Worker» را رد می‌کند.
signals.practical_impact: Legal permission to study does not guarantee that a particular university, funding package, or employment contract is operationally compatible with full-time study.
signals.who_should_care: Skilled Worker holders considering a master's or PhD, especially funded full-time PhD programmes.
signals.recommended_action: Check the specific university enrolment policy, funder/stipend terms and employer workload rules separately from immigration permission.
signals.known_workaround: Part-time study or a programme/funding arrangement compatible with sponsored work may resolve institution-specific conflicts.

official_verification.note: The legal permission to study is officially confirmed. Institution/funder friction remains case-specific community evidence.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Apply only when a specific university, funder or employer has a documented condition that conflicts with the proposed study/work combination.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: No country-level or route-level penalty is justified from institution-specific constraints.

signals.title: Historical Route 3 host-document delays and Statement of Guarantee rework

other_conditions: Global Talent Route 3 / UKRI endorsed-funder applicant relying on host-organisation documentation

signals.summary_en: Two independent early-2025 Route 3 experiences show host-university document preparation taking about one to six weeks; one applicant then lost roughly another month because the Statement of Guarantee did not contain the expected information/format. The applicant ultimately succeeded.

signals.recommended_action: Ask the host organisation to use current UKRI/Home Office requirements and verify all mandatory letter contents before submission.
signals.known_workaround: Early host-document preparation and internal sense-checking can reduce rework.

signals.title: BRP non-issuance after eVisa transition is now normal, not an application defect

other_conditions: UK immigration-status holders transitioning from physical BRP to eVisa

signals.summary_en: Early-2025 community confusion about not receiving a BRP after obtaining eVisa/share codes has been resolved by the digital-status transition. Current GOV.UK says eVisas have replaced physical immigration documents and all BRPs have expired.
signals.summary_fa: ابهام‌های اوایل ۲۰۲۵ درباره صادر نشدن BRP پس از فعال شدن eVisa با گذار رسمی به وضعیت دیجیتال برطرف شده است. GOV.UK اکنون اعلام می‌کند eVisa جایگزین مدارک فیزیکی شده و BRPها منقضی شده‌اند.
signals.practical_impact: Applicants should not interpret absence of a newly issued physical BRP as a current processing failure when their eVisa is valid.
signals.who_should_care: UK visa holders using eVisa/share codes, especially people relying on older BRP expectations.
signals.recommended_action: Use the UKVI account/eVisa and share-code process; keep identity-document details current.
signals.known_workaround: Use current GOV.UK eVisa troubleshooting if access itself fails.

official_verification.note: The current digital-status model is officially confirmed.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Resolved implementation transition: no negative fit adjustment.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The signal exists to remove an obsolete operational concern, not to add route points.

signals.title: IHS overlap refunds are automatic; ILR itself does not refund unused IHS

other_conditions: In-country visa switch or extension with overlapping IHS periods
Applicant considering ILR with unused time remaining on a prior visa

signals.summary_en: Community advice was mixed on IHS refunds. Current official guidance clarifies that qualifying overlapping IHS after an in-country switch/extension is refunded automatically in six-month blocks, while applying for ILR does not itself generate a refund of unused IHS.
signals.summary_fa: در جامعه درباره بازپرداخت IHS پاسخ‌های متناقض وجود داشت. راهنمای رسمی فعلی روشن می‌کند که در صورت پرداخت هم‌پوشان IHS پس از تمدید/تغییر ویزا در داخل بریتانیا، بازپرداخت واجد شرایط به‌صورت خودکار و در بازه‌های شش‌ماهه انجام می‌شود؛ اما درخواست ILR به‌خودی‌خود باعث بازپرداخت IHS استفاده‌نشده نمی‌شود.
signals.practical_impact: Incorrect refund assumptions can materially distort the cost of switching routes or settling.
signals.who_should_care: Applicants comparing the financial cost of an in-country switch, extension, or ILR application.
signals.recommended_action: Model IHS cash flow using the official overlap and six-month rules; do not assume an ILR application refunds remaining IHS.
signals.known_workaround: If a qualifying automatic refund is not received within the official timeframe, use UKVI's refund contact process.

official_verification.note: Current official refund rules resolve the conflicting community advice.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Cost clarification only; do not alter official eligibility or route fit from this signal alone.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: This affects budgeting rather than eligibility.

signals.title: Proposed fixed settlement-income threshold is not the current Global Talent rule

other_conditions: Global Talent holder planning settlement / ILR

signals.summary_en: The community repeatedly treated a fixed annual income threshold under Earned Settlement reform as a proposal rather than a current rule. Current GOV.UK Global Talent settlement evidence guidance says applicants must show UK earnings linked to their expert field and that there is no minimum earnings level. The Earned Settlement page remains a closed consultation.
signals.summary_fa: بحث‌های گروه، آستانه درآمد سالانه در طرح Earned Settlement را «پیشنهاد» و نه قانون جاری دانسته‌اند. راهنمای فعلی GOV.UK برای ILR در Global Talent می‌گوید باید درآمد مرتبط با حوزه تخصص در بریتانیا نشان داده شود و حداقل مبلغ درآمدی تعیین نشده است. صفحه Earned Settlement همچنان مشاوره بسته‌شده است.
signals.practical_impact: Treating consultation proposals as current law can wrongly downgrade Global Talent settlement feasibility.
signals.who_should_care: Global Talent holders planning ILR and comparing settlement pathways.
signals.recommended_action: Use the current Immigration Rules and official Global Talent settlement evidence guidance, and recheck if/when Earned Settlement reforms are formally implemented.
signals.known_workaround: None needed under the current fixed-minimum-income question; continue preserving evidence of UK earnings linked to the expert field.

official_verification.source_title: GOV.UK — Global Talent extension or settlement evidence
official_verification.note: Current official guidance explicitly says there is no minimum earnings level for the existing Global Talent earnings evidence requirement. Future reform remains monitorable.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Do not apply a penalty based on the proposed fixed income threshold unless a future Immigration Rule makes it operative for this route and applicant cohort.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: This signal prevents a proposal from being converted into a current legal requirement.

signals.title: Pending Global Talent endorsement alone does not protect expiring UK permission

other_conditions: Applicant already in the UK whose current permission may expire while Global Talent endorsement is pending

signals.summary_en: For an applicant already in the UK, a pending Global Talent endorsement or endorsement review does not by itself extend immigration permission. Current GOV.UK states that the visa/permission application is the step that can extend leave while a decision is pending. This is a legal-status distinction, not a community-derived rule.
signals.summary_fa: برای متقاضی داخل بریتانیا، صرفِ در انتظار بودن اندورسمنت یا endorsement review باعث تمدید اجازه اقامت نمی‌شود. GOV.UK فعلی تصریح می‌کند که درخواست ویزا/permission است که می‌تواند تا زمان تصمیم، وضعیت را تمدید کند. این تفاوت یک قاعده رسمی است، نه برداشت جامعه.
signals.practical_impact: Misunderstanding this distinction can lead to loss of lawful status even if the endorsement case is still pending.
signals.who_should_care: In-country Global Talent applicants whose existing permission will expire before Stage 1 is likely to finish.
signals.recommended_action: Use current GOV.UK guidance and obtain qualified immigration advice if needed before the existing permission expires; do not rely on Stage 1 alone to preserve status.
signals.known_workaround: Where the route and timing permit, GOV.UK allows the Global Talent visa application to be made at the same time as the endorsement application, but refusal of endorsement can affect Stage 2.

official_verification.source_title: GOV.UK — Global Talent researcher or academic overview
official_verification.note: Official guidance expressly distinguishes endorsement from the visa application for leave-extension purposes.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Apply only when the person is physically in the UK, their existing immigration permission may expire before Stage 1 finishes, and they have not made a valid visa/permission application that protects their status.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: This can directly prevent lawful continuation of the process. Do not double-count with the endorsement-delay penalty; use the larger status-risk penalty when this condition is met.

signals.title: Cold outreach may be ineffective for obtaining the required Route 4 recommendation

other_conditions: Route 4 applicant without an existing relationship to an eminent UK-resident expert who can write the required recommendation

signals.summary_en: One detailed 2025 experience reports very low response from roughly 100 cold approaches to academics for a Route 4 recommendation. The official requirement that the recommender be an eminent UK-resident person who knows the applicant and their work makes pure cold outreach structurally difficult, but one case is not enough to infer a broad access rate.
signals.summary_fa: یک تجربه در ۲۰۲۵ از پاسخ بسیار کم به حدود ۱۰۰ تماس سرد با اساتید برای توصیه‌نامه روت ۴ خبر می‌دهد. با توجه به الزام رسمی که توصیه‌کننده فردی برجسته، مقیم بریتانیا و آشنا با کار متقاضی باشد، تماس سرد می‌تواند دشوار باشد؛ اما این تک‌مورد برای تعمیم کافی نیست.
signals.practical_impact: Applicants without an existing scholarly relationship may underestimate the lead time required to secure a compliant recommendation.
signals.who_should_care: Route 4 peer-review applicants with no existing relationship to a suitable UK-resident expert.
signals.recommended_action: Prioritize genuine professional/research relationships and start recommender planning early; do not ask strangers merely to sign a letter.
signals.known_workaround: Develop a legitimate collaboration/network connection before filing if no suitable recommender already knows the work.

official_verification.note: Official recommender criteria are confirmed; the low response rate is a single historical anecdote.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Historical single anecdote: no fit penalty.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The signal is useful for planning lead time, not for legal eligibility scoring.

watchlist.what_would_confirm_it: Multiple independent documented complaints about the same publicly identifiable provider, a regulator/consumer-law finding, or verifiable contract/policy evidence.
